component.name: Karten
component.summary: Maps and route planning that also work offline

description.p: Karten is a simple map for the Plasma desktop. Search for a place, and plan a route there by car, by bicycle, on foot or by public transport.
Print a route as a roadbook: its instructions one below the other, each with its distance from the start and a small map of the junction.
Download a region to keep planning routes and finding places without an internet connection. Map data comes from OpenStreetMap.

Print a route as a roadbook, to navigate by without a screen: every instruction with its distance from the start and from the instruction before, and a small map of the junction that points the way you are going. A map of the whole route goes first. Print Route is in the menu and next to the route's duration; it works for routes by car, by bicycle and on foot.
Installed as a Flatpak, Karten now follows the desktop's colours when they change while it runs, and shows the icons of Plasma's global theme.

Routes by public transport: choose when to leave or arrive, pick one of several connections, and see its rides, changes and walks with their times. Connections come from Transitous and need an internet connection.
The button for showing your location is now a switch: while it is on, your location is shown and followed on the map; switching it off removes it again.
